Message.Name: Time Message
Message.Description: A Time message is sent whenever the source time for a unit passes over a second boundary.

Field.Name: Time
Field.Description: Number of whole seconds from midnight Eastern Time

Message.Name: Unit Clear Message
Message.Description: The Unit Clear message instructs feed recipients to clear all orders for the Cboe book in the unit specified in the Sequenced Unit Header. This message will be sent at startup each day.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Message.Name: Transaction Begin
Message.Description: The Transaction Begin message indicates any subsequent messages, up to the accompanying Transaction End message, are all part of the same transaction block.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Message.Name: Transaction End Message
Message.Description: The Transaction End message indicates that a transaction indicated by a previous Transaction Begin message has completed.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Message.Name: Complex Instrument Definition Expanded Message
Message.Description: A Complex Instrument Definition Expanded message represents a complex instrument that is available to place orders.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Id
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Id right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Underlying
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Underlying right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Type
Field.Description: 4 character field; each field describes a characteristic.

Field.Name: Leg Count
Field.Description: The number of legs in the complex instrument. The maximum number of legs is 12.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Leg
Field.Description: The number of legs in the complex instrument. The maximum number of legs is 12.

Message.Name: Symbol Mapping Message
Message.Description: A Symbol Mapping message is used to map the 6 character multicast feed symbol field to an OSI symbol and Underlying.

Field.Name: Feed Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: OSI Symbol
Field.Description: OSI Symbol

Field.Name: Symbol Condition
Field.Description: N = Normal C = Closing Only

Field.Name: Underlying
Field.Description: Symbol of underlying equity right padded with spaces. All spaces if not available or not applicable.

Message.Name: Add Order Long Message
Message.Description: An Add Order message represents a newly accepted visible order on the Cboe book.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Day-specific identifier assigned to this order

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: Order Side

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Instrument quantity added to the complex book (may be less than the number entered).

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Id
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Id right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The limit order price

Field.Name: Padding
Field.Description: Reserved

Message.Name: Add Order Short Message
Message.Description: An Add Order message represents a newly accepted visible order on the Cboe book.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Day-specific identifier assigned to this order

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: Order Side

Field.Name: Quantity Short
Field.Description: Instrument quantity being added to the complex book (may be less than the number entered).

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Id
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Id right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price Short
Field.Description: The limit order price

Field.Name: Padding
Field.Description: Reserved

Message.Name: Add Order Expanded Message
Message.Description: An Add Order message represents a newly accepted visible order on the Cboe book. Expanded version accommodates larger symbol sizes possible through the ISRA plan.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Day-specific identifier assigned to this order

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: Order Side

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Instrument quantity being added to the complex book (may be less than the number entered).

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Id 8
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Id right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The limit order price

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved

Field.Name: Participant ID
Field.Description: Optionally specified. If specified the Executing Broker of firm attributed to this quote.

Field.Name: Customer Indicator
Field.Description: Customer Indicator

Field.Name: Client ID
Field.Description: Optional user specified value attributed to this quote. Space filled otherwise.

Message.Name: Order Executed Message
Message.Description: Order Executed messages are sent when a visible order on the Cboe book is executed in whole or in part.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that was executed

Field.Name: Executed Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares/contracts executed

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this execution. Execution Id is also referenced in the Trade Break message

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: Options Only (byte not sent in Equities) (Space): Normal Trade S: Spread trade

Message.Name: Order Executed at Price Size Message
Message.Description: Order Executed at Price/Size messages are sent when a visible order on the Cboe book is executed in whole or in part at a different price than the limit price on the original Add Order message or the limit order price in the latest Modify Order message referencing the Order Id.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that was executed

Field.Name: Executed Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares/contracts executed

Field.Name: Remaining Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares/contracts remaining after the execution

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this execution. Execution Id is also referenced in the Trade Break message

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The execution price of the order

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: Trade Condition

Message.Name: Reduce Size Long Message
Message.Description: Reduce Size messages are sent when a visible order on the Cboe book is partially reduced.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been reduced

Field.Name: Canceled Quantity
Field.Description: Instrument quantity canceled

Message.Name: Reduce Size Short Message
Message.Description: Reduce Size messages are sent when a visible order on the Cboe book is partially reduced.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been reduced

Field.Name: Canceled Quantity Short
Field.Description: Instrument quantity canceled

Message.Name: Modify Order Long Message
Message.Description: The Modify Order message is sent whenever an open order is visibly modified. The Order Id refers to the Order Id of the original Add Order message.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been modified

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Instrument quantity associated with this complex order after this modify (may be less than the number entered)

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The limit order price after this modify

Field.Name: Padding
Field.Description: Reserved

Message.Name: Modify Order Short Message
Message.Description: The Modify Order message is sent whenever an open order is visibly modified. The Order Id refers to the Order Id of the original Add Order message.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been modified

Field.Name: Quantity Short
Field.Description: Instrument quantity associated with this complex order after this modify (may be less than the number entered)

Field.Name: Price Short
Field.Description: The limit order price after this modify

Field.Name: Padding
Field.Description: Reserved

Message.Name: Delete Order Message
Message.Description: The Delete Order message is sent whenever an open order is completely canceled. The Order Id refers to the Order Id of the original Add Order message.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has completely cancelled

Field.Name: Order Id

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: Always Buy Order regardless of resting side

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Instrument quantity traded

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Id

Field.Name: Execution Id

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: Options Trade Condition Codes

Message.Name: Trade Short Message
Message.Description: The Trade message provides information about executions of non-displayed orders on the Cboe book and routed executions to other trading centers.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of the executed order.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: Always Buy Order regardless of resting side

Field.Name: Quantity Short
Field.Description: Instrument quantity traded

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Id
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Id right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Price Short
Field.Description: The execution price of the order

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this trade.

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: Options Trade Condition Codes

Message.Name: Auction Notification Message
Message.Description: Auction Notification messages are used to disseminate order details of a complex auction.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Id
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Id right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Auction ID
Field.Description: Day specific identifier assigned to this auction.

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: Auction Type

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: B = Buy S = Sell

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Auction price.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Instrument quantity.

Field.Name: Customer Indicator
Field.Description: Customer Indicator

Field.Name: ParticipantID
Field.Description: Executing Broker (optional) of firm attributed to this quote.

Field.Name: Auction End Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last timestamp.

Field.Name: Client ID
Field.Description: Optional user specified value attributed to this quote. Space filled otherwise.

Message.Name: Auction Cancel Message
Message.Description: Auction Cancel messages are used to disseminate the cancelation of an earlier Auction Notification message as a result of a user cancelation of the original complex auction, a user modification request to change the complex auction price or increase the original complex auction quantity, a fading of the NBBO or to cancel any remaining complex auction quantity from the original Auction Notification following the complex auction termination.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Auction ID
Field.Description: Day specific identifier assigned to this auction

Message.Name: Auction Trade Message
Message.Description: Auction Trade messages are used to disseminate executions resulting from a complex auction.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Auction ID
Field.Description: Day specific identifier assigned to this auction

Field.Name: Execution ID
Field.Description: Day specific identifier assigned to this execution

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Trade price

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Instrument quantity traded

Message.Name: Trading Status Message
Message.Description: The Trading Status message is used to indicate the current trading status of a complex instrument.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Complex Symbol ID
Field.Description: Complex Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Unused
Field.Description: Reserved

Field.Name: Trading Status
Field.Description: Trading Status

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved

Field.Name: GTH Trading Status
Field.Description: GTH Trading Status (C1 Only)

Field.Name: Padding
Field.Description: Reserved

Message.Name: Auction Update Message
Message.Description: Options Auction Update messages are used to disseminate price and size information during the Opening and Re-Opening (halt) process for complex instruments.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument ID 8
Field.Description: Complex Instrument right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Auction Opening Type
Field.Description: Auction Opening Type

Field.Name: Reference Price
Field.Description: Not used for complex series. Will contain zero value.

Field.Name: Buy Contracts
Field.Description: Cumulative Buy interest at the Indicative Price.

Field.Name: Sell Contracts
Field.Description: Cumulative Sell interest at the Indicative Price.

Field.Name: Indicative Price
Field.Description: SNBBO Collared Volume Maximizing Imbalance Minimizing Price computed on combined Auction-Only and Continuous Book (if any).

Field.Name: Auction Only Price
Field.Description: Not used for complex series. Will contain zero value.

Field.Name: Opening Condition
Field.Description: Not used for Complex series. Will contain zero value.

Field.Name: Composite Market Bid Price
Field.Description: Not used for Complex series. Will contain zero value.

Field.Name: Composite Market Offer Price
Field.Description: Not used for complex series. Will contain zero value.

Message.Name: Auction Summary Message
Message.Description: Auction Summary messages are used to disseminate the results of an auction of a complex instrument. An Opening or Re-Opening Auction Summary message for each complex instrument is sent at the conclusion of its Opening or Re-Opening auction and represents Cboe opening price.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp.

Field.Name: Complex Instrument Id 8
Field.Description: Complex Instrument Id right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Auction Opening Type
Field.Description: Auction Opening Type

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Auction price

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Cumulative instrument quantity executed during the auction

Message.Name: End of Session Message
Message.Description: The End of Session message is sent for each unit when the unit shuts down. No more sequenced messages will be delivered for this unit, but heartbeats from the unit may be received.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Leg Symbol
Field.Description: Option or Equity Symbol of leg, right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Leg Ratio
Field.Description: Leg ratio (positive for buy-side, negative for sell-side). For options this is the number of contracts, for equities this is the number of shares.

Field.Name: Leg Security Type
Field.Description: Option or Equity instrument

Value.Description: Complex with Stock Options Auction Trade
